visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled frames show a OneCoin presentation with a title slide, bonus-plan material and closing "OneCoin — The future of payments" branding.
A chart slide labels scenarios as "Optimistic Scenario" and "Base Scenario" and visibly includes a disclaimer that the chart is based on projections and is not a financial forecast.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes buying OneCoin packages for tokens while associating the purchase with fourfold investment value, projected price growth, and token interest. It also encourages recruitment through direct-sales and matching bonuses, including a 10% reward tied to bringing in people whose group reaches a €5,500 balance within 30 days. These purchase-linked returns and recruitment incentives present a financial solicitation with unusually favorable benefit claims, although some comparisons, attributed statements, and figures are unverified and one chart labels its values as projections.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation promotes purchasing packages that include tokens used to mine OneCoins and claims returns from those tokens. Recruitment and group-based bonuses are also presented as an income mechanism, supporting S06 as a secondary subtype.
